description: Lists the direct children of a line of the nomenclature, to go down level by level from the chapters (2 digits) to the declarable 10-digit codes. Without a code it returns the sections and their chapters. Each line says whether it is declarable and how many children it has. Covers the EU customs tariff (TARIC) as applied in Spain (mainland and Balearic Islands). Not valid for the Canary Islands, Ceuta or Melilla. For guidance only, not binding.

code.description: 2 to 10 digits of the line to open (dots and spaces are accepted). Omit it to list the chapters.

date.description: Reference date as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today. From the first date available in the data up to one year ahead.

language.description: Language of the texts returned: Spanish (es), Catalan (ca) or English (en). Official EU texts not published in Catalan are returned in Spanish.

suffix.description: Two-digit line suffix, as returned for each line. Only needed for grouping lines that share the code of their first child. Default 80.

name: browse_nomenclature
title: Browse the nomenclature
